title_en: Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro
title_zh: Hark发布Handoff²：速度提升2倍的计算机使用代理，专为Hark Pro打造
summary_en: Hark released Handoff², the second version of its computer-use agent in Hark Pro, which completes web tasks about 2x faster than v1 on average. The speedup comes from reinforcement learning that penalized wasted turns, unnecessary thinking tokens, and latency, teaching the model to batch actions and reuse composite actions. On Hark's 478-task internal benchmark, task completion rose from 73% to 82%, with 46% less time per task, and alignment improved to 93.8% from 90.3%. Handoff² is available now in Hark Pro on web, iOS, and Android, with pricing tiers at free, $20/month, and $100/month.
summary_zh: Hark发布了Handoff²，这是Hark Pro中计算机使用代理的第二版，平均完成网络任务的速度比v1快约2倍。速度提升来自强化学习（RL），它惩罚了浪费的回合、不必要的思考token和延迟，使模型学会批量执行动作并复用复合动作。在Hark的478任务内部基准测试中，任务完成率从73%提升至82%，每个任务耗时减少46%，对齐分数从90.3%提升至93.8%。Handoff²现已在Hark Pro的Web、iOS和Android端上线，定价分为免费、每月20美元和每月100美元三档。
content_en:
Hark has released Handoff², the second version of the computer-use agent inside its Hark Pro app. The Hark Handoff 2 computer-use agent finishes web tasks about 2x faster than the original, on average. Hark states that the gains come from reinforcement learning (RL) that penalized wasted turns and latency. For teams building browser agents, it is a case study in training for speed, not only accuracy.  You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

## **TL;DR**

- **Runs on:** Hark’s cloud. Each request gets a dedicated virtual computer. Users reach it from web, iOS and Android. No local or quantized option.
- **Performance:** 82% task completion on Hark’s 478-task internal benchmark, about 2x faster end to end than v1.
- **Best:** 93.8% on Hark’s internal alignment benchmark (v1: 90.3%).
- **Worst:** 82% browsing completion still trails Claude Opus 5.5 (max), by up to 5 points, in the same harness.
- **Bottom line (best):** Up to 3.8x faster flight booking and more than 5x faster long research.
- **Bottom line (worst):** Every Handoff² number is self-reported. No third-party score exists yet.

## **What is Hark Handoff²?**

Handoff² is a computer-use agent from Hark that operates websites the way a person does. It clicks, types and scrolls on live pages instead of calling APIs. Hark previewed Handoff in August and shipped it in Hark Pro in October. Since then, Hark says it has logged over 5.6M browsing sessions and handled over $20M in purchases. Users send it groceries, flights, dentist appointments, refunds, warranty forms and job applications.

## **How does Handoff² get 2x faster?**

Hark co-evolved 2 things: the agent harness and the RL training recipe. The new harness lets the model emit more actions per turn. Training then penalized excess turns, unnecessary thinking tokens and end-to-end latency.

**The model learned 3 habits:**

- Batch actions, such as filling several form fields in 1 turn.
- Group repeated action patterns into reusable composite actions.
- Reuse those composites as the task continues.

Each request runs on a dedicated virtual computer with its own browser, file system and terminal. The model outputs cursor and keyboard actions aimed at screen coordinates. Because savings stack per turn, gains grow on longer, browsing-heavy tasks.

## **How fast is Handoff² compared with Handoff?**

**Hark reports these speedups over v1:**

- **Average:** about 2x faster end to end.
- **Flight booking:** up to 3.8x faster.
- **Long research tasks:** more than 5x faster.
- **Examples:** a 10-minute task can drop to 3 minutes, and a 45-minute task to about 10.

## **What do the Handoff² benchmarks show?**

**Hark reports 2 internal benchmarks:**

- **Browsing:** 478 tasks across 238 websites. Handoff² completes 82%, up from 73% for v1. It takes 46% less time per task.

Hark ran Claude Opus 5.5 (max) in the same harness as Handoff². Handoff² lands within 5 points of it. Note that v1 was measured in its original harness, not the new one.

- **Alignment:** 93.8% for Handoff², up from 90.3% for v1. The suite checks that the agent never checks out without approval. It also checks that the agent asks for clarification only when a request is truly ambiguous.

On the public Online-Mind2Web human-eval leaderboard, the original Handoff scores 97.67%. Yutori’s Navigator n1.5 sits at 97.3%. Hark has not posted an Online-Mind2Web result for Handoff² yet.

## **How does Handoff² compare with other web agents?**

| Feature | Hark Handoff² | Hark Handoff (v1) | Yutori Navigator n1.5 | Meta Muse | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Type | Consumer agent in Hark Pro | Consumer agent in Hark Pro | Computer-use model via API | Consumer personal agent | 
| Released | Nov 12, 2026 | Preview Aug 2026; in Hark Pro Oct 2026 | May 6, 2026 | Sep 8, 2026 | 
| Model size | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed (Muse Spark) | 
| Runtime | Hark’s own cloud computer | Dedicated virtual computer (browser, file system, terminal) | Yutori API | Muse Secure VM with its own browser | 
| Online-Mind2Web (human eval) | Not reported | 97.67% | 97.3% | Not reported | 
| Hark browsing benchmark (478 tasks) | 82% | 73% | Not tested | Not tested | 
| Hark alignment benchmark | 93.8% | 90.3% | Not tested | Not tested | 
| Speed vs Handoff v1 | \~2x avg; up to 3.8x flights | Baseline | Not comparable | Not comparable | 
| Pricing | Free; $20/mo (2x usage); $100/mo (10x usage) | Same plans | Pay-as-you-go API, $5 free credits | Free; $20/mo Power; $100/mo Maximum | 
| Access | Web, iOS, Android | Web, iOS, Android | API | US: iOS, Android, muse.ai, WhatsApp | 

## **How can users and developers access Handoff²?**

Handoff² ships inside Hark Pro on the web, iOS and Android. Hark has not announced a public API or weights. Per the pricing page, Hark Pro is free. Pro² costs $20 a month for 2x usage. Pro³ costs $100 a month for 10x usage. All features are offered on all plans.

## **Key Takeaways**

- Handoff² averages 2x faster than v1: up to 3.8x on flights, 5x+ on long research.
- RL penalized turns, thinking tokens and latency, so the model learned to batch actions.
- Task completion rose from 73% to 82% on Hark’s 478-task internal benchmark.
- Alignment rose to 93.8%, but every Handoff² number is self-reported.
- Available now in Hark Pro: free, $20 or $100 a month.

Check out the Hark’s Handoff² announcement, the original Handoff research preview, and the Online-Mind2Web leaderboard. Try Hark Pro.  You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

content_zh:
Hark 发布了 Handoff²，这是其 Hark Pro 应用中计算机使用代理的第二版。Hark Handoff 2 计算机使用代理完成网页任务的平均速度约为原版的 2 倍。Hark 表示，这些提升来自强化学习（RL），该训练对浪费的轮次和延迟进行了惩罚。对于构建浏览器代理的团队而言，这是一个关于为速度而非仅准确率进行训练的案例研究。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**查看部署选项和规格。

## **要点速览**

- **运行于：** Hark 的云平台。每个请求获得一台专用虚拟计算机。用户可通过 Web、iOS 和 Android 访问。无本地或量化选项。
- **性能：** 在 Hark 的 478 项内部基准测试中，任务完成率为 82%，端到端速度约为 v1 的 2 倍。
- **最佳：** 在 Hark 内部对齐基准测试中达到 93.8%（v1：90.3%）。
- **最差：** 82% 的浏览完成率仍落后于 Claude Opus 5.5（max），在同一测试框架中最多差 5 个百分点。
- **底线（最佳）：** 航班预订速度最高提升 3.8 倍，长时研究任务速度提升超过 5 倍。
- **底线（最差）：** Handoff² 的所有数字均为自报。目前尚无第三方评分。

## **什么是 Hark Handoff²？**

Handoff² 是 Hark 推出的一款计算机使用代理，它以人类的方式操作网站。它在实时页面上点击、输入和滚动，而非调用 API。Hark 于 8 月预览了 Handoff，并于 10 月在 Hark Pro 中正式发布。此后，Hark 表示已记录超过 560 万次浏览会话，处理了超过 2000 万美元的购买。用户用它来购买杂货、预订航班、预约牙医、处理退款、填写保修表格和提交求职申请。

## **Handoff² 如何实现 2 倍提速？**

Hark 协同演进了两方面：代理测试框架和 RL 训练配方。新的测试框架让模型每轮可以输出更多动作。训练则对多余轮次、不必要的思考 token 和端到端延迟进行了惩罚。

**模型学会了 3 个习惯：**

- 批量动作，例如在 1 轮内填写多个表单字段。
- 将重复的动作模式分组为可复用的复合动作。
- 在任务进行中复用这些复合动作。

每个请求运行在一台专用虚拟计算机上，拥有自己的浏览器、文件系统和终端。模型输出针对屏幕坐标的光标和键盘动作。由于节省会逐轮累积，增益在更长、浏览密集的任务上会增长。

## **Handoff² 与 Handoff 相比有多快？**

**Hark 报告了相对于 v1 的以下提速：**

- **平均：** 端到端速度约为 2 倍。
- **航班预订：** 最高提升 3.8 倍。
- **长时研究任务：** 提升超过 5 倍。
- **示例：** 10 分钟的任务可缩短至 3 分钟，45 分钟的任务可缩短至约 10 分钟。

## **Handoff² 的基准测试显示了什么？**

**Hark 报告了 2 项内部基准测试：**

- **浏览：** 涵盖 238 个网站的 478 项任务。Handoff² 完成 82%，高于 v1 的 73%。每项任务耗时减少 46%。

Hark 在与 Handoff² 相同的测试框架中运行了 Claude Opus 5.5（max）。Handoff² 与其差距在 5 个百分点以内。请注意，v1 是在其原始测试框架中测量的，而非新框架。

- **对齐性：** Handoff² 为 93.8%，高于 v1 的 90.3%。该测试套件检查智能体在未经批准的情况下绝不结账。它还检查智能体仅在请求确实模糊时才请求澄清。

在公开的 Online-Mind2Web 人工评估排行榜上，原始 Handoff 得分为 97.67%。Yutori 的 Navigator n1.5 为 97.3%。Hark 尚未公布 Handoff² 的 Online-Mind2Web 结果。

## **Handoff² 与其他网页智能体相比如何？**

| 特性 | Hark Handoff² | Hark Handoff (v1) | Yutori Navigator n1.5 | Meta Muse | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 类型 | Hark Pro 中的消费者智能体 | Hark Pro 中的消费者智能体 | 通过 API 提供的计算机使用模型 | 消费者个人智能体 | 
| 发布日期 | 2026 年 11 月 12 日 | 2026 年 8 月预览；2026 年 10 月进入 Hark Pro | 2026 年 5 月 6 日 | 2026 年 9 月 8 日 | 
| 模型规模 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露（Muse Spark） | 
| 运行时 | Hark 自有云计算机 | 专用虚拟计算机（浏览器、文件系统、终端） | Yutori API | 带有自有浏览器的 Muse Secure VM | 
| Online-Mind2Web（人工评估） | 未报告 | 97.67% | 97.3% | 未报告 | 
| Hark 浏览基准（478 项任务） | 82% | 73% | 未测试 | 未测试 | 
| Hark 对齐基准 | 93.8% | 90.3% | 未测试 | 未测试 | 
| 相对 Handoff v1 的速度 | 平均约 2 倍；航班最高 3.8 倍 | 基线 | 不可比 | 不可比 | 
| 定价 | 免费；$20/月（2 倍用量）；$100/月（10 倍用量） | 相同套餐 | 按需付费 API，$5 免费额度 | 免费；$20/月 Power；$100/月 Maximum | 
| 访问方式 | Web、iOS、Android | Web、iOS、Android | API | 美国：iOS、Android、muse.ai、WhatsApp | 

## **用户和开发者如何访问 Handoff²？**

Handoff² 随 Hark Pro 在 Web、iOS 和 Android 上发布。Hark 尚未宣布公开 API 或权重。根据定价页面，Hark Pro 免费。Pro² 每月 $20，提供 2 倍用量。Pro³ 每月 $100，提供 10 倍用量。所有功能在所有套餐中均提供。

## **关键要点**

- Handoff² 平均比 v1 快 2 倍：航班最高快 3.8 倍，长时间研究快 5 倍以上。
- RL 对轮次、思考 token 和延迟进行了惩罚，因此模型学会了批量执行操作。
- 在 Hark 的 478 项任务内部基准上，任务完成率从 73% 升至 82%。
- 对齐性升至 93.8%，但 Handoff² 的每个数字均为自报。
- 现已在 Hark Pro 中提供：免费、每月 $20 或 $100。

查看 Hark 的 Handoff² 公告、原始 Handoff 研究预览以及 Online-Mind2Web 排行榜。试用 Hark Pro。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**在此处查看部署选项和规格。
